div.div: غُنَامَاكَ أَنْ تَفَعَلَ كَذَا (S, K, * TA) means The utmost of thy power, or ability, and of thy case, (S, * TA,) and that which thou eagerly desirest like as one desires spoil, (S, * JM, TA, *) [is, or will be, thy doing such a thing;] i. q. قُصَارَاكَ: (K, TA: [see also عُنَانَاكَ, in art. عن:]) and so ↓ غُنْمُكَ : (TA:) and [in like manner] one says, أَنْ يَفْعَلَ كَذَا ↓ غُنَيْمَاؤُهُ , like حُسَيْنَاؤُهُ, meaning قُصَارَاهُ [The utmost of his power, &c.]. (TA in art. حسن.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
